audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows contradict their own reasons. Both layers read Neeko / Skill / Renekton / Renekton / Neeko / Renekton / Renekton, while whys[0] says he 'owns level 1 outright, and you have only single-target Q with no answer', whys[1] says his all-in 'still beats your second Q point', whys[4] calls Level 6 'a true coinflip', and whys[5] and whys[6] both describe Neeko taking over on items while 'Renekton falls off hard'. The packet chart (Renekton x4 / Skill / Neeko / Neeko) matches every reason.
audit.why: The chart currently hands Neeko the two stages the page calls his hardest and hands Renekton the two stages the page calls his falloff — it is inverted at both ends of the game.

audit.why: Four spikes, right shape: his Level 1-3 bully window, her Level 3 max-range answer, the coinflip Level 6, and her first-item takeover as he falls off.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; the Dominus claim inside spikes[2].text corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) DOMINUS DOES NOT HEAL. whys[4] says 'his Dominus heal and stun', spikes[2].text says 'his Dominus heal-and-fury', and mid says 'his Dominus heal and fury sustain'. Per Riot's text, Dominus grants bonus Health and damages nearby enemies — the healing in his kit is Cull the Meek (Q), a flat 7s cooldown that heals a portion of the damage dealt and heals more above 50 Fury. Three strings send the player to play around the wrong ability for his sustain. (b) MISSING, and it is the number the whole lane turns on: Ruthless Predator stuns 0.75s normally and 1.5s above 50 Fury. The page says 'never trade into a full rage bar' four times without ever saying what changes. (c) MISSING: no cooldowns anywhere — W is 16/14/12/10/8s, E is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Q is a flat 7s. (d) dosFull[1].t says 'Root the landing spot of Ruthless Predator (Stun)' — Ruthless Predator is a point-and-click stun at 300 range with no landing spot. (e) MISSING: Grievous Wounds, flagged in missingInteractions, appears only in report[8] and nowhere in the plan.
audit.why: 'Don't fight a full Fury bar' is advice a player cannot act on; 'above 50 Fury his stun doubles to 1.5 seconds' is. And a player who thinks his ultimate heals will build to burst through a heal that is not there, while ignoring the 7s Q that actually refunds all their poke.
audit.corrected: Cull the Meek (325 range, flat 7s) is the heal and it is why Oblivion Orb belongs in the first back. Ruthless Predator (300 range, 16s at rank 1) is point-and-click and stuns 0.75s, or 1.5s above 50 Fury. Slice and Dice covers 450 per charge on 16s at rank 1. Dominus is bonus health and an aura, not sustain.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text, ranges and cooldowns
